Class DisplayMapController

java.lang.Object
controller.DisplayMapController
public class DisplayMapController extends Object
Controller responsible for retrieving data for display purposes.

Provides methods to list all maps, list all cities, and verify the existence of a map. Internally obtains the repositories.
